Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list, really helpful. Quick answers up front and then an ask:

1) Invoice remit entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) is our default remit for hosted engagements. For EU customers we can invoice from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK) or Redwood Europe SARL (FR) depending on where the contract sits. If you want a single EU-facing invoice, we can route through Redwood Europe SARL and mark that on the order form.

2) VAT / reverse charge: We typically support reverse charge where appropriate. To finalize, we need your VAT registration number + a short certificate. If you can provide the Nebula VAT ID and the country-specific residency evidence we’ll confirm the recommendation.

3) Net terms & activation fees: We can accept Net45 in this deal (we generally do Net30, but will make an exception for strategic pilots). Activation/onboarding fees are usually invoiced up front unless you ask to have them amortized over the first invoice cycle — we can do either, though amortization requires an order-form appendix.

Next steps I propose:
- Can Procurement send the Nebula VAT ID and the PO entity name for the remit?
- I will prepare an order-form appendix that pins the invoice remit to Redwood Europe SARL and explicitly calls out Net45 and activation amortization (if you want).
- Internal: looping in Kimberly (tax/legal) and Lauren (finance) to confirm EU entity availability and to prepare tax evidence.

If that sounds good, I'll attach a redlined order form for your review by EOD tomorrow.
